title: Pure iron pillar of Delhi

tellings.quote: and they still stand. Or take the pillar in the center of Delhi in India.

plain: An iron pillar standing in the middle of Delhi, India, is still standing after all these centuries, according to Kiran Ilum Xenov, whom the episode presents as the president of a Russian republic and who says aliens took him in 1997. He brings it up with Michels as an example of ancient work that has lasted, alongside other old structures that "still stand", without naming a source.
